name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
title: HMA Agro Industries Ltd - 543929 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 standalone revenue of INR 67,689 mn (+39.2%) and EBITDA margin 3.12%, but no capacity, capex or utilisation figure given; Q4 revenue growth only ~4% and Q&A dodged several numeric questions.

triggers.label: Export prices not passing through
triggers.quote: Since we are not able to rise -- pass on the rise in our input cost to the customers

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth ~4% YoY
triggers.quote: reflecting a healthy growth of approximately 4%

triggers.label: INR 10,000 cr revenue target FY27
triggers.quote: getting the INR 10,000 crores revenue in FY27

guidance.value: INR 10,000 crores (raised by analyst; management reiterated intent to reach INR 1 billion organisation)
guidance.quote: we will be entering into the INR 1 billion organization
